edits.old: Then the stale block shows the business date of its last refresh and marks nothing as fresh
edits.new:
Then the stale block shows the business date of its last refresh and marks nothing as fresh

  Scenario: AC9 The scheduled refresh runs in rwb-case without a shared job table
    Given the freshness Schedule is due in rwb-case
    When the Schedule runs refreshStaleSet
    Then the stale set is refreshed through the workflow kit and no Quartz job table and no shared job table is read
    And the reconciliation and key-resolution reads follow the read shape Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0728; ASM-1278)

  Scenario: AC10 The provided operations answer 401, 403 and 404 with no data
    Given a call to a provided operation with no valid user, or with a user without the right, or for a resource that does not exist
    When the call is made
    Then the call is answered 401 with no valid user, 403 without the right and 404 for a resource that does not exist, and no data shows

  Scenario: AC11 A freshness read that does not answer is retried once and never shown as fresh
    Given the rwb-source-data freshness read does not answer inside the 2 s budget
    When refreshStaleSet runs
    Then the activity retries the GET once
    And when the retry does not answer the stale block shows the business date of its last refresh and marks nothing as fresh

  Scenario: AC12 A failed consumed call shows its error state and resolves no key
    Given the rwb-source-data reconciliation read or the key-resolution read fails
    When I open the console
    Then the affected block shows its error state
    And no key is reported as resolved without an answer
